cards.name: Welcome to Resonance: Core
cards.desc:
# RESONANCE: CORE
*A strange new game shows up on every computer in town. It's funny, it's harmless, and it has a cute little guide named HELPR. Then something breaks the Core, and the game starts coming out.*

A story-driven text RP on Roblox, inspired by **Homestuck**, **Deltarune**, and **Earthbound**.

**Worldsong Online** just appeared on every PC in **Stillwater**. Nobody installed it. Nobody knows who made it. Everybody's playing it.

cards.name: How to Join
cards.desc:
1. Join the Discord and read **#rules**.
2. Read this Trello (start with **Characters**, **Titles**, **Magic**, and **Stats**).
3. Grab the **Character Template** from **#how-to-submit**.
4. Post your filled template in **#character-submissions**.
5. Wait for a Reviewer to approve it or ask for changes.
6. Once approved, you get the **Player** role. Welcome to Stillwater.

cards.name: What You Submit
cards.desc:
- Real character (art, bio, personality, stats)
- Game Avatar (name, look, stats)
- Title (Role + Element)
- Boons & Flaws
- 3 starting abilities
- Biography

⚠️ **Your Magic is permanent.** It will shape your other powers later in the story. Choose carefully.

cards.name: Schedule
cards.desc:
- **Canon story events** happen **once a week**. That's when the story moves forward.
- **Free RP runs 24/7.** Grind, fight, hang out, and stat farm in both worlds whenever you want.
- Event times are posted in **#event-schedule**.

cards.name: Glossary
cards.desc:
- **WSO:** Worldsong Online, the game.
- **Overworld:** the real town of Stillwater.
- **Game Avatar:** your character inside WSO.
- **Title:** your Role + Element, like *Herald of Static*.
- **MP:** Magic Points. What your abilities cost.
- **Ability tag:** the required tag at the end of every combat action.
- **Notes:** WSO money.
- **PVE / PVP:** fighting enemies / fighting players.

cards.name: General Server Rules
cards.desc:
1. Be respectful. No harassment, slurs, or targeting real people.
2. Keep OOC drama out of IC, and IC drama out of OOC.
3. Follow Discord's and Roblox's Terms of Service.
4. Staff decisions are final. Disagree respectfully in a ticket.
5. No spoiling story events for people who missed them.

cards.name: RP Rules
cards.desc:
- **No metagaming:** your character only knows what they learned IC.
- **No godmodding:** you can't auto-hit, auto-dodge, or ignore damage.
- **No powergaming:** stay inside your approved abilities, stats, and items.
- Respect the setting. WSO is a game; Stillwater is a normal town (for now).

cards.name: Combat Rules
cards.desc:
- Combat is **turn-based**.
- Every combat action **must** end with an **ability tag**. No tag = the action doesn't count.
- One action per turn plus movement.
- Use only approved abilities and items.

cards.name: PVP Rules
cards.desc:
- **Anyone can jump or kill anyone.** No consent needed.
- **Fights in the Overworld are life or death.**
- **Villains are allowed.** Make one and go crazy.
- Kills only count if the fight used **ability tags**. Staff can review the chat log if there's a dispute.
- Certain PVP logs can earn **XP or instant rank-ups**. Staff watch for abuse (like trading wins with friends).

cards.name: Combat Logging
cards.desc:
**Combat logging** = leaving while you're actively in an in-character fight.

Staff decide what happens **case by case**, since real disconnects happen.

cards.name: PVE Rules
cards.desc: PVE (fighting enemies) only runs when **staff are on**, or when **approved by staff/helpers**.

cards.name: Stillwater
cards.desc:
The **Overworld**. An ordinary small town: suburbs, a main street, a mall, a school, a diner, an arcade. Nothing important has ever happened here.

You play your **real character** in Stillwater.

cards.name: Worldsong Online (WSO)
cards.desc:
An **MMORPG** that showed up on every computer in Stillwater overnight. No publisher. No website. No update notes. Everyone calls it **WSO**.

You play your **Game Avatar** inside WSO.

cards.name: Logging In
cards.desc:
1. Walk up to any computer in Stillwater and press the button.
2. The PC boots and the desktop opens.
3. Click **Worldsong Online**.
4. The first time, you'll build your **Game Avatar**.
5. You spawn on **Firstlight Isle**, high in the sky.

cards.name: Firstlight Isle
cards.desc:
WSO's starter zone: a peaceful tutorial island floating in the sky. Grassy cliffs, a spawn plaza with a fountain, training dummies, a starter shop, and the **Combiner**.

At the center, a ring of standing stones surrounds a big shining crystal: **the Core**.

Around the edges are huge glowing archways leading down through the clouds: the **portals** to WSO's other worlds. They're closed for now.

cards.name: HELPR
cards.desc:
WSO's tutorial guide. A small floating mascot with a round body, a static-filled screen for a face with one big pixel eye, tiny paws, and a "!" that pops over its head.

Hyper, cheerful, full of bad puns, and calls everyone **PLAYER**. Types in ALL CAPS.

> HELLO PLAYER!! WELCOME TO WORLDSONG ONLINE!!! I'M HELPR, YOUR HELPFUL HELPER WHO HELPS :D

cards.name: The Core
cards.desc:
A huge shining crystal at the center of Firstlight Isle, surrounded by standing stones.

> THAT BIG SHINY ROCK IS THE CORE!! PLEASE DO NOT LICK THE CORE :D — HELPR

cards.name: Your Two Characters
cards.desc:
Every player has two characters:
- **Real character:** who you are in Stillwater.
- **Game Avatar:** who you are inside WSO. Can look completely different.

They have **separate stats and separate HP**.

cards.name: Character Creation Steps
cards.desc:
1. Make your real character.
2. Build your Game Avatar.
3. Pick your **Title** (Role + Element).
4. Pick **Boons & Flaws** (optional).
5. Spend **5 stat points** for each character.
6. Write **3 starting abilities**.
7. Submit.

cards.name: About Titles
cards.desc:
Your **Title** is a **Role + Element**, like *Herald of Static*.

- The **Element** is **WHAT** your Magic is.
- The **Role** is **HOW** you use it.

You pick your own. 12 Elements × 10 Roles = **120 possible Titles**.

⚠️ **Titles are permanent.**

cards.name: Static
cards.desc:
**Element: Static**

Theme: Electricity, noise, interference.

Every ability you make must fit this theme.

cards.name: Signal
cards.desc:
**Element: Signal**

Theme: Sound, communication, transmission.

Every ability you make must fit this theme.

cards.name: Echo
cards.desc:
**Element: Echo**

Theme: Memory, repetition, copies.

Every ability you make must fit this theme.

cards.name: Dream
cards.desc:
**Element: Dream**

Theme: Sleep, illusion, the subconscious.

Every ability you make must fit this theme.

cards.name: Rot
cards.desc:
**Element: Rot**

Theme: Decay, weakening, things falling apart.

Every ability you make must fit this theme.

cards.name: Bloom
cards.desc:
**Element: Bloom**

Theme: Growth, life, healing.

Every ability you make must fit this theme.

cards.name: Glare
cards.desc:
**Element: Glare**

Theme: Light, heat, exposure.

Every ability you make must fit this theme.

cards.name: Hush
cards.desc:
**Element: Hush**

Theme: Silence, shadow, hiding.

Every ability you make must fit this theme.

cards.name: Weight
cards.desc:
**Element: Weight**

Theme: Gravity, pressure, force.

Every ability you make must fit this theme.

cards.name: Pulse
cards.desc:
**Element: Pulse**

Theme: Heartbeat, emotion, rhythm.

Every ability you make must fit this theme.

cards.name: Glitch
cards.desc:
**Element: Glitch**

Theme: Errors, rule-breaking, randomness.

Every ability you make must fit this theme.

cards.name: Frost
cards.desc:
**Element: Frost**

Theme: Cold, stillness, preservation.

Every ability you make must fit this theme.

cards.name: Title Rules
cards.desc:
- Roles **lean** toward a category. They don't lock you in.
- **At least 1** of your starting 3 abilities must match your Role's lean.
- Every ability must fit your **Element's** theme.
- Your Title is **permanent**.

cards.name: Herald
cards.desc:
**Role: Herald**

Broadcasts the element outward. Wide, spread-out effects.

**Leans toward:** Offense

cards.name: Breaker
cards.desc:
**Role: Breaker**

Destroys with it. Hits hard, single target.

**Leans toward:** Offense

cards.name: Warden
cards.desc:
**Role: Warden**

Guards with it. Walls, shields, protecting others.

**Leans toward:** Defense

cards.name: Drifter
cards.desc:
**Role: Drifter**

Moves through it. Dodging, repositioning, escaping.

**Leans toward:** Defense

cards.name: Mender
cards.desc:
**Role: Mender**

Repairs with it. Healing, fixing, undoing damage.

**Leans toward:** Support

cards.name: Carrier
cards.desc:
**Role: Carrier**

Gives it to others. Buffs and empowering allies.

**Leans toward:** Support

cards.name: Taker
cards.desc:
**Role: Taker**

Steals it from others. Drains, debuffs, siphons.

**Leans toward:** Offense / Support

cards.name: Weaver
cards.desc:
**Role: Weaver**

Shapes it into things. Constructs, traps, tools.

**Leans toward:** Utility

cards.name: Caller
cards.desc:
**Role: Caller**

Summons things made of it. Minions, creatures, familiars.

**Leans toward:** Utility

cards.name: Reader
cards.desc:
**Role: Reader**

Senses and understands it. Info, tracking, weak points.

**Leans toward:** Utility

cards.name: Magic
cards.desc:
Your Game Avatar's power, granted by WSO and built around your **Title**.

Magic costs **MP (Magic Points)**.

⚠️ **Whatever you pick for your Magic is PERMANENT and will shape your other powers later in the story.**

cards.name: Custom Abilities
cards.desc:
You make your **own** abilities. Every ability picks:
- **One category** (Offense, Defense, Support, Utility)
- **One tier** (Hum, Ring, Roar, Quiet)

Staff approve every ability before you can use it.

cards.name: Categories
cards.desc:
- **Offense:** deals damage
- **Defense:** blocks, reduces, or redirects damage
- **Support:** heals or boosts allies
- **Utility:** movement, sensing, or out-of-combat use

cards.name: Tiers
cards.desc:
| Tier | Cost | Damage / Block / Heal | Unlocks |
|---|---|---|---|
| Hum | 3 MP | 8 | Start |
| Ring | 6 MP | 15 | Lv 5 |
| Roar | 10 MP | 25 | Lv 10 |
| Quiet | 16 MP | 40 (once per fight) | Lv 15 |

Defense and healing use the same numbers as damage.

cards.name: Ability Rules
cards.desc:
- One main effect, **at most one** side effect.
- **Banned:** instant kills, time stop, mind control of another player's character without consent, knowing everything.
- Upgrading an ability to a higher tier needs **re-approval**.
- Start with **3** abilities, +1 at **Lv 5, 10, 15, 20** (7 total).

cards.name: Ability Tag (REQUIRED)
cards.desc:
Every combat action **must** end with this tag:

**[ Ability Name | Tier | 15 DMG | 6 MP ]**

⚠️ **No tag = your action doesn't count.**

cards.name: Blank Disk
cards.desc:
An extremely rare item. The **only** way to change your Magic.

- Rare event rewards and rare finds only. Never buyable.
- One use. One per character, ever.

cards.name: Stat System
cards.desc:
**Magic** uses numbers. Everything else uses **letter grades**:

**F → E → D → C → B → A → S**

Just look up your letter. No math.

cards.name: Stamina
cards.desc:
**Physical actions per fight.** Basic attacks and Recharge each use 1.

| F | E | D | C | B | A | S |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 3 | 4 | 5 | 6 | 7 | 8 | 10 |

cards.name: Speed
cards.desc:
- Higher letter **acts first**.
- Higher letter **wins chases and escapes**.
- You can **dodge one attack per fight** if your Speed is higher than the attacker's.

cards.name: Magic (MP)
cards.desc:
- Base **20 MP**.
- **+3 MP** per point.
- Max **15 points** in Magic.

cards.name: Points & Upgrades
cards.desc:
- Everyone starts at **E** in all letter stats and **20 MP**.
- **5 points** at creation, **+2 points** every level.

| Upgrade | F→E | E→D | D→C | C→B | B→A | A→S |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cost | 1 | 1 | 2 | 2 | 3 | 4 |

Your real character and Game Avatar have **separate** stats.

cards.name: Boons & Flaws Rules
cards.desc:
- Pick **up to 2 Boons**. Every Boon you take requires **1 Flaw**.
- You can take up to **2 Flaws** with no Boons, just for RP.
- You **can't** take a Boon and its opposite Flaw.
- They apply to **both** your real character and your Game Avatar.
- **Permanent.** A Blank Disk does not change them.

cards.name: BOON: Sturdy
cards.desc:
**+10 HP**

Opposite Flaw: **Glass Jaw**

cards.name: BOON: Hard Hitter
cards.desc:
**Basic attack +1 damage**

Opposite Flaw: **Weak Arm**

cards.name: BOON: Quick Start
cards.desc:
**Always act first in round 1 (ties go to Speed)**

Opposite Flaw: **Slowpoke**

cards.name: BOON: Second Wind
cards.desc: **Once per fight, Recharge restores 10 MP instead of 6**

cards.name: BOON: Iron Will
cards.desc: **Once per fight, survive a hit that would drop you to 0 HP at 1 HP instead**

cards.name: BOON: Lucky
cards.desc:
**Once per fight, dodge one attack no matter the Speed**

Opposite Flaw: **Clumsy**

cards.name: BOON: Iron Gut
cards.desc:
**Healing items heal +3**

Opposite Flaw: **Lightweight**

cards.name: BOON: Pack Rat
cards.desc:
**+3 inventory slots, and 4 consumables per fight**

Opposite Flaw: **Butterfingers**

cards.name: BOON: Haggler
cards.desc:
**Items cost 10 Notes / $2 less (min 1)**

Opposite Flaw: **Broke**

cards.name: BOON: Tinkerer
cards.desc: **Combiner is free, and once a week you can combine 3 items**

cards.name: BOON: Streetwise
cards.desc: **+1 Speed letter in Overworld chases and escapes**

cards.name: BOON: Grinder
cards.desc: **+5 XP on every approved training, PVE, and PVP log**

cards.name: FLAW: Weak Arm
cards.desc: **Basic attack -1 damage (min 1)**

cards.name: FLAW: Slowpoke
cards.desc: **Always act last in round 1**

cards.name: FLAW: Clumsy
cards.desc: **Can never dodge with Speed**

cards.name: FLAW: Lightweight
cards.desc: **Healing items heal -3**

cards.name: FLAW: Butterfingers
cards.desc: **Max 2 consumables per fight**

cards.name: FLAW: Broke
cards.desc: **Start with no money, and items cost 10 Notes / $2 more**

cards.name: FLAW: Tired
cards.desc: **-1 Stamina action per fight**

cards.name: FLAW: Hothead
cards.desc: **If someone insults you mid-fight, your next action has to target them**

cards.name: FLAW: Coward
cards.desc: **Below 15 HP, you have to try to escape on your turn**

cards.name: FLAW: Phobia
cards.desc: **Pick a fear. When it's present, you lose your first turn**

cards.name: FLAW: Loud
cards.desc: **You can never sneak. Every stealth attempt fails.**

cards.name: How Combat Works
cards.desc:
- **Turn-based.**
- **Your turn:** 1 action (ability, basic attack, item, or Recharge) plus movement.
- **Turn order:** players go in the order they joined the fight, then enemies act. Higher Speed goes first.

cards.name: Damage, Block & Heal
cards.desc:
| | Basic | Hum | Ring | Roar | Quiet |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Amount | Strength | 8 | 15 | 25 | 40 |
| Cost | 1 Stamina | 3 MP | 6 MP | 10 MP | 16 MP |

Defense blocks and healing restores the same amount as same-tier damage.

cards.name: Recharge
cards.desc: Skip your attack to get back **6 MP**. Uses 1 Stamina action.

cards.name: Losing in WSO
cards.desc: Right now, losing a fight in WSO has no lasting consequences. It's just a game.

cards.name: Fighting in the Overworld
cards.desc: Fights in Stillwater are **life or death.**

cards.name: Money
cards.desc:
- **WSO:** **Notes**. Start with **100**.
- **Overworld:** dollars. Start with **$50**.

cards.name: Inventory Rules
cards.desc:
- Using an item **takes your action**.
- Max **3 consumables per fight**.
- **10 inventory slots.** Same items stack up to 5 per slot.
- Get items from shops, staff PVE drops, and quest/event rewards.

cards.name: Minor Potion (WSO)
cards.desc: Heal **8 HP**. **20 Notes**.

cards.name: Potion (WSO)
cards.desc: Heal **15 HP**. **50 Notes**.

cards.name: Mega Potion (WSO)
cards.desc: Heal **25 HP**. **120 Notes**.

cards.name: Mana Drop (WSO)
cards.desc: Restore **6 MP**. **40 Notes**.

cards.name: Smoke Bomb (WSO)
cards.desc: Escape a fight automatically, ignoring Speed. **60 Notes**.

cards.name: Return Scroll (WSO)
cards.desc: Teleport back to Firstlight Isle (out of combat only). **30 Notes**.

cards.name: Snack (Overworld)
cards.desc: Cookie, chips, etc. Heal **8 HP**. **$2**.

cards.name: Meal (Overworld)
cards.desc: Burger, pizza, etc. Heal **15 HP**. **$8**.

cards.name: First Aid Kit (Overworld)
cards.desc: Heal **25 HP** *or* treat one injury. **$25**.

cards.name: Flashlight (Overworld)
cards.desc: Needed in dark areas. **$10**.

cards.name: Gear
cards.desc:
Equip **1 weapon, 1 armor, 1 accessory**.

- **Weapon upgrades** (rare): +1 or +2 basic attack damage
- **Armor** (rare): +5 or +10 HP
- **Accessory** (rare): one small perk (e.g. +1 Stamina action, +3 MP)

cards.name: Weapon Types
cards.desc:
Pick **any object** as your weapon: sword, umbrella, frying pan, guitar, gun. It's flavor. Damage still comes from your **Strength** letter (plus upgrades).

**Guns:** allowed. **Very hard to get** in the Overworld. In WSO they're fine and not especially rare.

cards.name: The Combiner
cards.desc:
On **Firstlight Isle**. Merge two items into one new (probably ridiculous) item for **50 Notes**. Write it up; staff approve it.

> I COMBINED A SPOON AND A SMOKE BOMB!! NOW I HAVE NO SPOON AND NO SMOKE BOMB :D — HELPR

cards.name: Levels
cards.desc:
- **150 XP per level**, every level.
- Max level: **20**.
- Every level: **+2 stat points**.
- New abilities at **Lv 5, 10, 15, 20**.
- No level caps. Staff may award extra XP for great RP.

cards.name: XP Sources
cards.desc:
| Source | XP |
|---|---|
| Weekly canon event | 100 |
| Ruler fight / big event win | +50 |
| Staff-run PVE | 25 small / 50 big |
| Training log (approved) | 10 (max 3/day) |
| Approved PVP log | 30 win / 10 loss |
| Exceptional PVP log | Instant rank-up |

cards.name: Logs
cards.desc:
Post logs in the Discord for approval:
- **#pvp-logs** for fights
- **#training-logs** for Overworld training
- **#pve-logs** for staff PVE

XP only counts after a staff member or helper approves it.

cards.name: Fluffbit
cards.desc:
**Minion.** A puffball bunny with a little antenna.

**Bonk:** Hum, 8 DMG.

cards.name: Puddlejelly
cards.desc:
**Minion.** A wobbly blue slime that squeaks.

**Splash:** Hum, 8 DMG.

cards.name: Dennis the Training Dummy
cards.desc:
**Standard.** HELPR's practice dummy. Fights back. Nobody knows why.

**Wobble Slap:** Hum, 8 DMG.
**Stand There:** Hum, blocks 8.

> THIS IS DENNIS!! DENNIS IS A DUMMY!! DON'T TELL HIM I SAID THAT :D

cards.name: Cloudmoth
cards.desc:
**Standard.** A fluffy moth that sheds glittery dust.

**Glitter Dust:** Hum, 8 DMG. Target's next attack does half.

cards.name: Sentry Stone
cards.desc:
**Elite.** One of the standing stones around the Core, awake and grumpy.

**Stone Fist:** Hum, 8 DMG.
**Ground Slam:** Ring, 15 DMG to everyone in front.

cards.name: King Fluffbit
cards.desc:
**Boss.** A Fluffbit the size of a house with a tiny crown.

**Royal Bonk:** Hum.
**Carrot Barrage:** Ring, hits everyone.
**Belly Flop:** Roar, 25 DMG.

cards.name: Resonance
cards.desc:
When the Core broke, your Magic bled into your real self and awakened as **Resonance**. People who have it are **Resonants**.

- **Mirror:** your Resonance has the same abilities as your Magic, in real-world versions.
- Works in the **Overworld** until the worlds merge.
- Staff can approve **alterations** later to make it better or more unique.

cards.name: Focus (FP)
cards.desc:
Resonance costs **FP (Focus)**.
- Base **20 FP**. Each Magic point gives **+3 MP and +3 FP**.
- Same tier costs as MP: Hum 3, Ring 6, Roar 10, Quiet 16.

cards.name: Breathe
cards.desc: Skip your attack to get back **6 FP**. Uses 1 Stamina action.

cards.name: Traces
cards.desc:
Resonance shows on your body as **Traces**: circuit-style lines with thick block segments and panel shapes around the joints, like the seams of a machine under your skin.

- Any limb(s). Any color you choose.
- Proof the Core is broken. Your power came from inside the game.

cards.name: Traces: Flare
cards.desc:
Traces flare when you use Resonance:
- **Hum:** faint glow
- **Ring:** bright glow
- **Roar:** lines pulse and light spills past them
- **Quiet:** Traces go fully **dark** for a beat, then flare all at once

cards.name: Traces: Lv 20
cards.desc: Traces stay the same size until **Lv 20**. Then they grow outward from your starting limbs, connect across your chest and back, and a few lines reach your face.

cards.name: Crashes
cards.desc:
Losing in WSO isn't just a game anymore.

Going down in WSO (**PVE or PVP**) is a **Crash**: your Avatar is force-logged out and you wake up at your PC in Stillwater.

The Overworld is still **life or death**.

cards.name: 1st Crash: Glitched
cards.desc: Dazed. **No Resonance for 1 hour** real time.

cards.name: 2nd Crash: Injured
cards.desc: A real injury you RP. Must be **treated before the next weekly event** (medical RP, Mender abilities, healing items, or a First Aid Kit).

cards.name: 3rd Crash: Corrupted
cards.desc: Pick a **memory** your character loses, plus an **injury** that needs treatment the same way.

cards.name: Crash Rules
cards.desc:
- Crash count **resets every arc**.
- **No charbanning.** The only way you sit out is if an injury isn't treated in time, and then only the next weekly event. Free RP is still allowed.
- **Permadeath in WSO** only if you agree.

cards.name: The Lumari
cards.desc:
An alien race whose real world was devoured. What's left of it is preserved inside WSO. The Lumari there are **survivors, not NPCs**.

Singular and plural: *a Lumari, the Lumari.*

cards.name: Lumari: Look
cards.desc:
- Horns, with a shape unique to each Lumari
- Bright, saturated skin in any color
- Sharp teeth and glowing eyes
- Limbs and fingers just slightly too long
- Faces that go eerily still when they're serious

cards.name: Lumari: Culture
cards.desc:
Loud, snarky, and competitive. They **rank everything**. Insults are how they show affection. Underneath the attitude is grief.

Their homeworld, **Ilunae**, was built around music. Most Lumari still hum without realizing it, then stop themselves.

cards.name: Lumari: Names
cards.desc: Day to day, Lumari go by **handles**. Their **real names** are verses from their own song, each with a meaning. They only tell their real name to someone they trust with their life.

cards.name: Lumari: Echoes
cards.desc: Small objects saved from their dead world. Each one holds a tiny piece of Ilunae's song. Losing one is losing a piece of home forever. (RP flavor only. Lost on a Crash.)

cards.name: Lumari: Typing Quirks
cards.desc: Every Lumari has a typing quirk. It's how their voice comes through text.

cards.name: Aurenne-That-Remains
cards.desc:
The Lumari's old capital, **Aurenne** ("the bright city"), preserved inside WSO at the exact second their world ended. Towers of colored glass, bridges, concert halls. Blinding colors and **no sound at all**.

It's not officially part of the game. Its edges glitch, and the skybox is wrong.

cards.name: Playing a Lumari
cards.desc:
- One Lumari OC per player. Around 20 server-wide.
- Played in WSO instead of your Avatar. One set of stats.
- Same Magic system: Title, custom abilities, MP.
- No Resonance until the worlds merge, then they gain Traces.
- Lose an echo on a Crash.

cards.name: HELPR
cards.desc:
> my name is saelu. i'm sorry i didn't say it sooner.

**[ HELPR NOT FOUND ]**

cards.name: The Core (Broken)
cards.desc:
The Core shattered. Its shards scattered and fell with pieces of Firstlight Isle, each one corrupting a world of WSO.

Each shard returned to the Core breaks the seal on the next portal.

cards.name: Dark Worlds
cards.desc:
Each fallen shard corrupted one of WSO's worlds into a **Dark World**.

- Only the **current arc's portal** is open.
- Each Dark World has a **Ruler** holding the shard.
- Beat the Ruler, take the shard, and the world is **restored**. That's the only way to see what it really looked like.
- Dark Worlds are **loud** and full of music. If the music ever starts cutting out... leave.

cards.name: Arc 2: The Overgrowth
cards.desc:
**Normally:** Greenhollow, a cheerful starter forest and meadow zone.
**Now:** everything grows wrong and won't stop.
**Ruler:** Keeper Fennick, the Grove Keeper, stuck handing out impossible quests.

cards.name: Arc 3: Low Tide
cards.desc:
**Normally:** Brightwater Bay, a beach and harbor fishing zone.
**Now:** the water's gone and a drowned town is left. Its creatures crawl into Stillwater at night.
**Ruler:** Brinemaw, the Bay's old raid boss.

cards.name: Arc 4: The Clearance
cards.desc:
**Normally:** Coinspire Market, WSO's big trade city.
**Now:** everything is for sale, including you. It's bleeding into the **mall**.
**Ruler:** King Pricewell, the Merchant King.

cards.name: Arc 5: The Unwritten
cards.desc:
**Normally:** the Endless Archive, a library zone.
**Now:** pages erasing, history deleting itself. It's bleeding into the **school**.
**Ruler:** the Archivist.
